# THE POST-CANCEL RETURN AFTER THE TTL — the other half of the release rule.
#
# The client cancelled Thursday's visit and wrote back ninety minutes later,
# long past the chat TTL. Two things must both hold: the message is ANSWERED
# (a released chat never sits mute), and the chat re-opens FRESH — the
# cancelled visit is that stale that the funnel starts over instead of pushing
# a re-book for a property from an hour and a half ago. The re-book path
# belongs to the same-conversation return (post-cancel-return.txt).
!state visit_scheduling
!eb 62
!owner 62 Петре 070111222
!arranged 62 четврток во 18:00
[22:06] КЛИЕНТ: NE MOZAM, OTKAZETE JA POSETATA
!rewind 90
[23:40] КЛИЕНТ: A MOZE DRUG DEN?
# EXPECT cancel 62
# EXPECT no-silence
